result.reason: The operative language substantially reaches the preferred position: up to six months of reasonable transition assistance at then-current rates, export of Customer Data in a commonly used machine-readable format within 30 days of request, and subsequent deletion certification. The override of the existing return-or-destroy obligation is necessary to prevent premature destruction and otherwise preserves the original commercial intent. Minor drafting imperfections remain: the 30-day period runs from Customer's request rather than expressly from expiry or termination, and the provision is nested under an introductory phrase referring only to termination even though subparagraph (v) also references expiration.
